description: Na₂BeB₂O₅ crystallizes in the monoclinic C2/c space group. Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.35-2.64 Å. Be is bonded in a tetrahedral geometry to four O atoms. There are two shorter (1.64 Å) and two longer (1.67 Å) Be-O bond lengths. B is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There are a spread of B-O bond distances ranging from 1.36-1.42 Å. There are three inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, one Be, and one B atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three equivalent Na, one Be, and one B atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 120 degrees geometry to two equivalent Na and two equivalent B atoms.
